svg.title: Scaled school-court plan and bench segment
svg.desc: First-party school-court scale drawing. At a single drawing unit of 20 pixels per centimeter, a 14 centimeter by 7 centimeter rectangular plan represents a 28 meter by 14 meter real court, at scale 1 drawing centimeter to 2 actual meters. A 9 meter bench is a separate 4.5 centimeter, 90-pixel line segment. Every drawing and real dimension is labeled; students must make and measure their own copy and account for units.
svg.text: School court at 1 drawing cm : 2 actual m
Scale key: 20 pixels on this diagram = 1 cm of drawing
Original Edulytiks model: measure and label an independent court sketch.
